thaumicomniverse.maid.choose_station: Maid selected: use a charging device to bind; sneak-use to unbind
thaumicomniverse.maid.station_limit: At most 8 charging stations can be bound; unbind one first
modifier.thaumicfutures.thaumic.descript: Thaumium grants upgrade slots: one per part on two-part tools, otherwise one per two parts, rounded up.
modifier.thaumicomniverse.thaumic.descri: Thaumium grants upgrade slots: one per part on two-part tools, otherwise one per two parts, rounded up.
omniverse.compass.searching: Searching for an unconquered eldritch obelisk…
omniverse.compass.none: No searchable eldritch obelisks in this dimension
omniverse.page.sinister_compass: A sinister stone senses rifts into the Outer Lands. Hold this compass to locate the nearest unconquered obelisk in your dimension and display its horizontal distance. The needle spins while searching. Defeating a pearl-bearing maze boss marks its obelisk conquered for everyone.
omniverse.page.primal_compass: A primordial pearl lets the compass distinguish an obelisk’s guardian. Use it to cycle between any boss, golem, warden, crimson cult and taint. Changing the filter starts a new search for the nearest matching unconquered obelisk.
omniverse.page.thaumaturge_certificate: Gather the accomplishments of thaumaturgy around a primordial pearl. Infusion costs 64 of every registered aspect, or 640 for primal aspects, with instability 30. Installed addons contribute further components. Combine nine blocks to compress them; compression is reversible.
item.thaumicomniverse.focus_pouch_upgrad: Switch wand foci from this backpack, preferring their original slots.
omniverse.page.focus_pouch_upgrade: This upgrade lets a carried backpack supply the wand focus selector. Returning foci prefer their previous slots, falling back to another empty slot when needed. Existing magnet upgrades also collect vis orbs into your hotbar wands or the wands inside the backpack. Their XP pickup toggle controls this feature. Placed backpacks can charge their stored wands too.
item.thaumicomniverse.essentia_tank_upgr: Uses two inventory columns, storing 8 essentia of one aspect per replaced slot. Uses the tank upgrade's stack multiplier. Connect tubes on any face.
omniverse.page.essentia_tank_upgrade: The tank holds 64 essentia of one aspect. A placed backpack connects on all six faces with the suction of an unlabelled jar, stopping intake when full. Convenient tubes and phials also work. Contents stay in the upgrade when removed; disabling it stops transfers. Open its tab to see the current aspect and amount.
item.thaumicomniverse.essentia_pump_upgr: Moves essentia into or out of the essentia tank.
omniverse.page.essentia_pump_upgrade: Requires an enabled essentia tank upgrade. Select input or output and toggle held-container and adjacent-storage interactions independently. Transfers up to 8 essentia per second; phials move in complete units of 8 and jars respect capacity and labels. Carried backpacks use the holder's hands; placed backpacks use held containers of players within three blocks. Disable the corresponding switch to stop automatic interaction. Unreturnable transfer remainders are retained in this upgrade and restored to its tank first.
omniverse.arcane.intoStorage.on: Crafted items go to the backpack first
omniverse.arcane.intoStorage.off: Crafted items go to the player inventory first
omniverse.arcane.refill.on: Refill consumed crafting ingredients from the backpack
omniverse.arcane.rotate: Rotate ingredients; hold Shift to reverse
omniverse.arcane.clear: Return crafting ingredients; keep them if no room
omniverse.node_map.forecast: Based on the last stabilizer and permanent node state. Individual recovered aspects are randomly chosen on load.
omniverse.page.scanned_node_map: With JourneyMap installed on the client, personally scanned aura nodes appear on the minimap and fullscreen map. Use the Show aura nodes button in the fullscreen map addon toolbar, assign the Toggle scanned aura nodes key or use the Omniverse client configuration to toggle them. The server saves discoveries per player and does not reveal another player's nodes. Loaded nodes show their latest confirmed amounts. Unloaded markers use ~ and forecast recovery from the last stabilizer and permanent node state. The core randomly selects recovered aspects on reload, so the map shows possible ranges rather than inventing exact values. Tracking never force-loads chunks.
tc.research_page.CONVENIENTTUBES.1: You have rebuilt essentia tubing in alchemical brass. Servos actively move essentia without suction. Use a servo on an arm connected to a container: each servo extracts one unit every ten ticks, and several can share a tube. Full destinations stop extraction; nearer containers take priority. Labels restrict filtered tubes to one aspect. A restricted tube counts as one thousand steps. Use a wand on an arm to toggle its connection, or sneak-use the wand to remove its servo. Ordinary suction tubes do not relay this network.
thaumicomniverse.alignment.title: Thaumic Alignment
thaumicomniverse.alignment.no_recipe: Insert a central ingredient and complete its research. Use ordinary pedestals nearby and alignment pedestals on the outer ring.
thaumicomniverse.alignment.mismatch: Materials or vector do not match
thaumicomniverse.alignment.rejected: Needs alignment research, a wand, materials and exact alignment; Journey also requires T4
thaumicomniverse.book.alignment.1: Thaumic Omniverse alignment unlocks after Infusion; Journey additionally requires its T4 breakthrough. Put ordinary arcane pedestals at the eight nearby positions with X/Z offsets -2, 0, 2, excluding the center, at the same height. Alignment pedestals go on the boundary of a 9×9 square. Center and nearby materials are normal inputs. Outer positive/negative offerings add/subtract aspects; both are consumed. Stacking pedestals use the full stack; ordinary ones hold one.
thaumicomniverse.book.alignment.2: Use the core empty-handed to see the current vector, target, difference, yield and risk; sneak-use retrieves its center item. Start with a wand; Journey additionally requires a T4+ wand. Every aspect must match exactly. Excess item count or diversity lowers yield in 0.75 steps, never below one, and raises risk. Symmetric infusion stabilizers reduce risk. Inputs are held during processing; changing offerings cannot change the running result. Breaking the core or a pedestal refunds held inputs. Chunk unload pauses; reload resumes.
thaumicomniverse.book.alignment.3: Example one: quartz at the center, ender pearl and salis mundus nearby; yields 1–16 aligned crystals. Example two: amethyst shard at the center with the same nearby materials; its target comes from seeded random candidates. The reference solution is not disclosed. Find an equivalent alignment from the displayed target. Vessels use normal item aspect rules and are consumed. Aligned crystals are example materials available to pack recipes.
thaumicomniverse.soul_core.bind: Right-click to bind your research knowledge
thaumicomniverse.soul_core.automation: Craft with a wand for automation use; craft the wand alone to remove
omniverse.page.soul_core:
A brain in a jar preserves thoughts; a soul core links machines to your research. Right-click the core to bind it to yourself, then craft it with a wand. Real players use their own research. Fake players, such as animated tool tables and deployers, borrow the bound owner's current research even while the owner is offline. Craft the wand alone to recover the bound core without losing wand data.

With Thaumic Energistics, put the core into an arcane assembler knowledge slot. It offers ordinary arcane recipes you have researched. An encoded arcane pattern in the selection slot restricts its recipes and also supports recipes with special item data. Research changes update automatically.

Craft a bound soul core with an unbound one to copy its binding. The original bound core is returned.
omniverse.page.universal_enchantment: You have linked this foreign enchantment to infusion. Put an eligible item on the central pedestal, arrange the listed components around it, and start with a wand. Compatibility and level limits still apply. With Apotheosis, infusion reaches one level beyond its effective limit; only that final level requires a void seed.
omniverse.page.sanity.text: Perhaps insanity might not be the greatest tool in all of occasions. For those cases, a nice bath generally takes care of it. A brew might be a better format for such a task, though...
omniverse.page.universal_clusters: Ordered essence draws the valuable fraction out of ores. This process accepts ore tags from other worlds of technology, producing two clusters from an ore block or one from a raw ore. Each cluster smelts into twice the normal smelting product. GregTech materials use native clusters, which can also be macerated for one and a half times the raw-ore output. The recipe viewer lists the materials available in this world.
omniverse.page.universal_transmutation: Every metal has a characteristic affinity, such as greed for gold or exchange for copper. Combining that affinity with Metallum triples an ingot or nugget of the same material. Ingots consume nine times the essence of nuggets. These authored affinities belong to material tags and also apply to new items using those tags.
omniverse.page.arcane_modules: A two-by-two arcane module may be fitted into a Draconic Evolution chestpiece. Only one arcane module may be installed. The four tiers grant 3%, 6%, 9% and 12% vis discounts, and 5, 10, 15 and 20 potency. The effects also work when the chestpiece is equipped in a body accessory slot. They stop as soon as the chestpiece is removed.
omniverse.page.arcane_assembly: For an alchemical mechanism, start with an alchemical brass sheet, deploy a vis filter and convenient essentia tube, add 4 machina and 8 praecantatio in a crucible, then press. When alchemical brass is disabled, use a golden sheet and ordinary essentia tube.
omniverse.page.solid_aura: Deployer kills condense their vis drops into aura granules. Using one releases six vis distributed randomly among the primal aspects. Nine make a storage block. Heated mixing turns one into 10 mB of liquid aura. A spout uses each mB to restore two durability to Repair-enchanted equipment, or one vis to a wand. Wands stay beneath the spout, waiting for more liquid as needed, until all primal aspects are full.
thaumicomniverse.gt.hatch: Capacity: %s essentia; draws from the front without a side restriction
thaumicomniverse.gt.generator: Output: %s EU/t; consumes essentia and lubricant
omniverse.page.gt_materials: Thaumium, void metal, alchemical brass, and installed addons' ichorium and thauminite have GregTech material forms. The six shards and amber have ore processing chains; shards can also make tools. Thaumcraft cinnabar ore shares GregTech cinnabar tags and processing. Mercury can be solidified with a ball mold into quicksilver and extracted again. The new vein contains the six shard ores, amber and cinnabar. It generates in the Overworld, or in the mining dimension with Allthemodium. Clusters smelt into twice the raw ore output or macerate into 1.5 times its crushed output. See JEI for processing recipes.
omniverse.page.essentia_engine: An EV-era engine converts essentia into 4096 EU/t, comparable to an EV large turbine. Fuel values retain the relative values of GTNH essentia fuels, scaled to twice their energy per unit. Each batch consumes four essentia and 1 mB lubricant. Build the JEI-displayed structure from arcane casing, with one essentia input hatch, a lubricant input, an EV-or-higher energy output and the usual maintenance and muffler parts. No air intake is required. LV hatches hold 64 of one aspect; each following tier doubles this. They pull from the reservoir in front regardless of its orientation, and accept essentia pipes or convenient pipes.
omniverse.page.essentia_railway: Thaumium and voidmetal crowbars retain Railcraft rotation and coupling controls; voidmetal repairs itself. The jar minecart holds 64 essentia of one aspect. Phials transfer eight units. Infusion and other devices using remote essentia extraction can draw directly from it while it moves. Contents survive unloading, reloading and breaking the cart. Place an essentia loader above the track (one or two blocks) and an unloader below it. Each buffers 256 units and transfers four per tick. Pipe faces connect on sides away from the cart. Loaders draw from adjacent storage; unloaders deliver to it. The interface keeps Railcraft cart filters and departure modes.
item.thaumicomniverse.essentia_tank_upgr: The essentia tank is too full for this backpack capacity.
omniverse.page.arcane_contraptions: Thaumic devices can travel on contraptions, except aura nodes. Dismantle formed fixed multiblocks and finish active infusions before assembly. Lenses scan individual carried blocks. Infusion draws from each moving jar at its actual position. Consumers on a contraption share its essentia containers and respect jar labels.
omniverse.page.thaumic_casing: Greatwood framed in thaumium forms a casing for arcane machinery.
omniverse.page.arcane_motor: Generates 256 su at 16 rpm passively. Relay power replaces the passive output: each ignis cv/t supplies 1024 su; each ordo cv/t adds 25%, and every two aer cv/t double rpm. Each aspect is capped at 8 cv/t.
omniverse.page.arcane_burner:
Craft an empty burner and capture a blaze. It accepts essentia through suction or direct input, storing 8 ignis and 8 potentia. One ignis burns for 20 seconds; superheating consumes one of each every 5 seconds. Solid fuels are not accepted.

Empty and idle burners provide passive boiler heat. Burning provides level 1 heat; superheating provides level 2.
omniverse.page.thaumic_crank:
Each click turns the crank for 4 seconds. A golem selects the connected crank with the least time remaining. One or two earth upgrades extend its turn to 6 or 8 seconds.

Selection range matches the golem's work radius, including water upgrades.
omniverse.page.void_mechanisms: Void sandpaper has 16 durability, repairs itself, and takes no damage in deployers. Upgrade a copper backtank to a self-repairing, warping voidmetal backtank with the same air capacity as netherite. The silverwood magic grip adds half a block of reach and accepts Repair.
omniverse.page.wand_charger: Receives vis without relaying it. Insert a wand to charge it. A wand with a bound soul core lets adjacent mechanical crafters perform arcane recipes using the bound player's knowledge, waiting for enough vis. On a contraption it also charges deployer-held wands and repairs eligible tools enchanted with Repair.
omniverse.page.arcane_suspension:
Use an upward and a downward coupler as a pair without rotational power. The lower coupler includes its partner and connected blocks within 10 blocks above during assembly and disassembly. Full blocks obstruct the link.

Stack up to three upward couplers below the link to reach 10, 20, or 30 blocks.
omniverse.page.arcane_magnet:
Attracts the nearest Thaumic Magnetic Casing and its connected structure. Casings are directionless; each actual casing position is searched, including casings on assemblies held by other magnets. New magnets place the structure on arrival. The side setting also assembles or places an adjacent structure.

Base range: 16 blocks. Aer and ordo accept up to 4 cv/t each, adding 6 blocks per point, up to 64. RPM changes speed immediately during travel. Faster magnets may take over after the current trip ends. Empty-hand use on the face cycles easing. Redstone prevents new trips; losing power places the structure immediately. Ordinary collisions are ignored, but working actors may stall it.

Mechanical presses produce thaumium and void metal sheets sharing GregTech plate tags.
omniverse.page.floating_depot: Two fixed depots share one flying tray. Sneak-use the input before placing the output. Only the input accepts items and quantity settings. The tray returns after the output is emptied. Its curve depends only on the endpoints, travelling at about 5 m/s, tripled while the input supplies Aer vis. Unloaded chunks pause travel. Maximum link distance: 8 blocks measured by Manhattan distance, including height.
omniverse.page.essentia_spout:
Each spout holds 64 units of one aspect and processes items on belts or depots. Single-aspect crucible recipes become spouting recipes; multiple aspects become a one-loop sequence. Arrange spouts in the order shown by JEI. For recipes sharing a catalyst and first aspect, set the desired final output in the first spout's side filter. Automated processing ignores research.

Crucible steps in sequenced assembly also accept successive injections in aspect-name order, at most 64 units each. The assembly advances only after every cost is paid. Phials, jars and labels can mark an aspect, including inside Create filters.
omniverse.page.essentia_switch:
Create's native threshold switch also measures essentia containers, retaining its item/fluid detection and native screen. A jar containing 48 of 64 essentia shows 75%. Upper and lower thresholds retain native hysteresis.

Select aspects with phials, jars, labels, or Create filters containing them. Capacity is counted once. Placed legacy essentia switches migrate automatically, preserving filters, thresholds, orientation and inversion; legacy items can also be crafted into native switches.
omniverse.page.portable_essentia: Opposing stationary and moving interfaces connect to expose all essentia aboard a contraption. Transfers respect existing contents and jar labels; each container retains its own capacity.
omniverse.page.arcane_contraptions.actor: Levitators, arcane doors, mirrors and growing/breeding lamps work while moving. Bores drill in their actual direction at half range, stalling the structure while working. Inverted crucibles spill like wand-emptying. Golems bind and mark individual moving containers, retaining locations through assembly/disassembly; other moving tasks are disabled. Schematics copy construction and settings, never inventories, vis, identities or active rituals.
omniverse.page.thaumic_casing.recipe: Apply a thaumium ingot to a greatwood log to make a Thaumic Casing. Deployers can perform the same operation; see JEI. Alchemical brass ingots can be pressed into sheets, interchangeable with GregTech plates.
omniverse.page.magic_hand.recipe: Use mechanical crafters without vis. From top to bottom: a thaumium ingot, an alchemical mechanism, a row of silverwood planks, a silverwood wand rod between silverwood planks, and a brass hand. See JEI for the complete layout.
omniverse.page.neural_models: Bind blank data models to Thaumcraft creatures and train them through combat. Creatures found in the Outer Lands produce a shared dimensional prediction. Combine it with ordinary substrates to reconstruct Outer Lands stone; fabricate specific loot in the Loot Fabricator.
omniverse.page.essentia_dynamo: Stores a total of 64 mixed essentia. Fuels match the Large Essentia Generator and yield one quarter of its energy at 4 FE/EU. Base power follows the Stirling Dynamo and common dynamo upgrades apply.
info.thaumicomniverse.essentia_dynamo: Burns essentia to generate Redstone Flux. Holds 64 mixed essentia and accepts dynamo augments.
thaumicomniverse.crafter.wand: Insert a wand with a bound Soul Core
omniverse.depot.select_hint: Sneak-use to select an input, then place the output. Sneak-attack clears selection.
omniverse.page.focus_kinetic: Continuously spend 2 cv/t each of Aer, Ignis and Ordo to power the targeted shaft face. Default: 128 RPM. Hold the focus function key for Create's speed board; release to save. Sneak-use reverses direction. Base stress equals a mechanical press at 256 RPM; each Potency adds 20%. Releasing use stops ordinary casting. Architect is available at rank 3: sneak + function key opens the program, and use starts it. Await waits for another use on the same face. The following two ranks may take Enlarge, adding 3 operations each, up to 11. Turning spends vis continuously; waiting is free. Double speed spends double vis and requires a configured speed no greater than 128 RPM. Changing hands, exceeding 16 blocks or running out of vis stops the sequence.
omniverse.page.focus_relocation: Continuously spend 2 cv/t each of Aer, Terra and Ordo. Attack or use a block to assemble it and its connected structure; attack a wand-created structure to disassemble it using Create rules. This focus prevents ordinary mining. Hold use to move; collisions clip only the blocked axis. Scroll to rotate; sneak-scroll to pull closer or push farther. Released structures persist. Native pistons and pulleys retain their travel limits; gantries follow their shaft, bearings rotate on their axis, and trains/carts follow rails. Architect: sneak-attack the first corner, then attack the second to assemble the cuboid without adding glue. Initial edge limit: 8; each Enlarge adds 8, subject to Create's block limit.
thaumicomniverse.focus.await_click: Await pauses until you use the target face again.
thaumicomniverse.focus.selection_size: Each selection side may span at most %s blocks.
thaumicomniverse.focus.selected: First corner selected; attack the other corner.
thaumicomniverse.focus.blocked: Cannot move: obstructed space, range limit or immovable blocks.
thaumicomniverse.focus.too_fast: Double speed requires a configured speed of at most 128 RPM. Sequence stopped.
omniverse.depot.out_of_range: Cannot link: endpoint Manhattan distance must not exceed %s blocks.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.tables.pu: Wooden Tables are the starting point for a magical workshop.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.tables.re: Place two Tables side by side, then use Scribing Tools on one to form a Research Table.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.tables.ar: Use a Wand on a separate Table to turn it into an Arcane Workbench.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.tables.us: The Research Table uses paper, ink and research notes. Keep both halves in place.
Use a Wand on a Cauldron to create a Crucible.
A heat source directly below the Crucible heats its water.
Fill the Crucible with water and wait for it to boil before adding ingredients.
Dissolve ingredients to supply the recipe aspects, then add its catalyst. Check the Thaumonomicon or JEI for the amounts.
Here, four Greatwood Logs supply 4 Praecantatio. One Iron Ingot becomes Thaumium, leaving the wood aspects behind.
Leftover aspects can decay and cause Flux. Sneak-use a Wand to empty the Crucible; avoid wasting large batches.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.distillat: An Alchemical Furnace burns fuel to break items down into their aspects.
Arcane Alembics above the furnace collect the separated Essentia.
Connect the Alembic to the top of a Warded Jar using Essentia Tubes.
Essentia moves toward stronger suction. Ordinary tubes reduce the suction signal by one per segment.
A label fixes the accepted aspect. An unlabelled Jar draws with 32 suction; a labelled Jar uses 64.
A full ordinary Jar stops drawing. Its top connection is also the only pipe access.
Void Jars keep accepting excess Essentia and destroy the overflow. Use them deliberately.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.suction.c: Different aspect demands can meet in a shared pipe. Similar suction strengths can make it vent and stop transferring.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.suction.d: Use a Wand on a pipe arm to close that connection and separate competing branches.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.suction.f: Label a Filtered Tube to allow only the selected aspect through this branch.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.suction.v: A Valve can stop flow. Right-click it to switch it manually, or control it with redstone.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.suction.r: A Restricted Tube halves the suction it receives, giving another branch priority.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.suction.o: A One-way Tube only outputs through its outlet. Use a Wand on its centre to change the orientation.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.suction.b: A Buffer holds up to eight Essentia. Bellows increase its suction; sneak-use a Wand on an arm to adjust that outlet.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.infusion_: Start a 3 by 3 footprint: Arcane Stone Bricks at the four corners and an Arcane Pedestal in the centre.
Place one Arcane Stone block above each corner. The lower bricks and upper stone are different materials.
Place the Runic Matrix two blocks above the central Pedestal, leaving one empty block between them.
Keep the other spaces inside this 3 by 3 by 3 structure empty while forming it.
Complete the Infusion research, then use a charged Wand on the Matrix. The base cost is 25 of each primal Vis.
The central Pedestal holds the item being transformed. Here, a Thaumium Pickaxe will become a Pickaxe of the Core.
Place the recipe components on separate surrounding Pedestals. Their positions can be arranged symmetrically.
Use a Wand on the Matrix to begin. Nearby Jars supply the required Essentia without pipes to the Matrix.
After receiving the Essentia and components, the altar places the finished item on the central Pedestal.
Balance Pedestals and stabilizers around the centre. Symmetric candles help reduce instability.
Missing ingredients or an unbalanced layout can interrupt the process. Keep spare ingredients and Essentia ready.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.thaumator: Begin with a Crucible above a working heat source.
Stack two Alchemical Constructs directly above the Crucible.
After the Thaumatorium research, use a Wand on a Construct. Base cost: 15 Ignis, 30 Ordo and 30 Aqua.
Feed catalysts as items and supply the requested Essentia through pipes. Keep the heat source in place.
Open the controller and select an unlocked recipe. It draws the aspects for that recipe instead of dissolving arbitrary ingredients.
Catalysts enter from the hopper. After the requested Essentia arrives, the result leaves from the front.
Attach Mnemonic Matrices to expand the number of remembered recipes.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.advanced_: Place an Alchemical Furnace at the centre of the lower layer.
Surround it with eight Advanced Alchemical Constructs to complete the 3 by 3 base.
Place four Arcane Alembics at the corners of the upper layer.
Fill the four edge centres with ordinary Alchemical Constructs. The top centre is not part of the blueprint.
After its research, use a Wand on a Construct. Base cost: 50 Ignis, 50 Aqua and 50 Ordo.
The working furnace needs Ignis, Aqua and Perditio Vis from a nearby network.
Drop items into the central opening. Extract Essentia through the lower side outlets.
The item dissolves into its aspects. Receiving Jars draw the matching Essentia out through pipes.
The bottom layer has Nether Bricks at its four corners. Fill the edges and centre with Obsidian.
Repeat the corner pattern in the middle layer, with a lava source at its centre.
Replace exactly one middle-layer edge with Iron Bars. This becomes the output face.
The top layer repeats the outer ring. Keep its centre empty for the input opening.
After the Infernal Furnace research, use a Wand on the structure. Base cost: 50 Ignis and 50 Terra.
Drop smeltable items through the top. Finished items leave through the face that had Iron Bars.
Bellows on the other sides improve the furnace. Keep the output and top opening clear.
Locate an Aura Node before building the capture shell around it.
Enclose the node in a 3 by 3 by 3 cube: 26 Glass blocks around the central node.
Cover the cube with a complete 3 by 3 layer of wooden slabs. Do not use double slabs.
Complete the Node in a Jar research and use a Wand on the shell. Base cost: 70 of each primal Vis.
The shell becomes a single Node in a Jar that can be picked up and transported.
Use a Wand to release the node. Capture can lower its brightness, so avoid repeated packing.
Place a Node Stabilizer directly below an Aura Node.
Place a Node Transducer directly above the same node.
Power the upper Transducer with redstone. Keep the lower Stabilizer unpowered and allow the conversion to finish.
The energized node supplies continuous primal Vis to nearby devices and Relays.
Keep both devices in place and the Transducer powered. Breaking the support or interrupting power can collapse the energized state.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.vis_relay: An energized node is the source of a Vis network.
Place a Relay within 8 blocks of its upstream node, with an unobstructed connection.
Relays extend the network. A Workbench Charger receives Vis for the Wand in the workbench below.
A solid obstruction breaks the connection. Move the Relay or clear its line of sight.
Use a Wand to cycle the Relay attunement. Different attuned colours do not connect directly; an unattuned endpoint can connect to either.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.bore.moun: Mount the Arcane Bore on its Base and point the head toward the area to excavate.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.bore.tool: Open the Bore and provide both a Pickaxe and an Excavation Focus. An exhausted pickaxe stops mining.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.bore.outp: Place an inventory at the Base output to collect mined items.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.bore.dig: Apply redstone to the Base or head to begin. The head scans the area in front of it.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.bore.boos: Perditio Vis or suitable Essentia can accelerate work. Pickaxe and Focus upgrades affect the result.
Find a naturally generated Eldritch altar with its Dark Node and obelisk intact.
Insert four Eldritch Eyes into the altar. Be prepared for its guardians.
Complete the relevant Eldritch research, then use a Wand on the altar. Base cost: 100 of each primal Vis.
The Dark Node is replaced by the portal into the Outer Lands.
A decorative copy is not a prepared gateway. Do not dismantle the original monument while using it.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.convenien: Convenient Tubes connect storage devices. Jars still connect through their top faces.
Use an Essentia Servo on the pipe arm touching the source. This marks the extraction end.
Each Servo moves one Essentia every 10 ticks. This network routes actively and does not use ordinary suction.
If no destination accepts the Essentia, extraction waits. Put Servos on sources, not on receiving Jars.
Sneak-use a Wand on the Servo arm to recover the Servo.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.routing.b: Several destinations can share one Convenient Tube network.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.routing.f: A labelled Convenient Filter only allows its selected aspect along that branch.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.routing.p: Convenient Restrictors make a route less preferred. They change routing priority rather than halving suction.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.routing.o: When the preferred destination is full, an accepting destination on the restricted route can receive the overflow.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.routing.i: Use a Wand on an arm to isolate a branch. Ordinary suction pipes do not form part of this network.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.motor.bas: An Arcane Motor supplies a small base rotation even without Vis: 16 RPM and 256 SU.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.motor.fir: Nearby Ignis Vis increases its stress capacity, allowing more machines to run.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.motor.ord: Ordo Vis further improves capacity while Ignis is available.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.motor.air: Aer Vis increases rotation speed. Gearing and machine stress must still suit the faster network.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.motor.bud: Vis is consumed continuously and shared with other devices. Insufficient supply changes the output.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.burner.em: An empty Arcane Blaze Burner must first capture a Blaze.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.burner.ca: Right-click a Blaze with the empty burner, then place the filled burner.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.burner.fi: Supply Ignis Essentia through pipes for normal heating.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.burner.po: Supplying both Ignis and Potentia produces superheating. Potentia alone is not enough.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.burner.he: Use it beneath heated processing setups or boilers. It consumes Essentia rather than ordinary burner fuel items.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.interface: Place one Portable Essentia Interface on a moving structure and another on the stationary side, facing each other.
Leave one or two empty blocks between the faces. The structure pauses while the interfaces connect.
The stationary interface exposes the Essentia storage carried by the whole connected structure.
Connect pipes to the back or sides. The front face is reserved for docking.
After transfers stop, the interfaces release and the structure continues moving.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.charger.r: Place a Wand Charger within 8 blocks of a visible Vis source or Relay.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.charger.w: Insert a rechargeable Wand or a supported tool with the Repair enchantment. The charger receives the Vis it needs.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.charger.d: A charger attached to a Deployer can charge or repair the tool held by that Deployer. It can attach on all six faces.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.charger.l: The charger is a receiving endpoint. Other machines cannot use it as a Relay.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.charger_c: Build a vertical Mechanical Crafter grid. Route every input toward the output and cover unused slots.
Attach a Wand Charger to a crafter. Insert a wand with an enabled Soul Core bound to a player who has unlocked the recipe.
Supply the wand through either protruding side of the charger. The two other sides cannot receive Vis.
Read the recipe from top to bottom: the gold ingot for a Node Stabilizer goes in the TOP MIDDLE slot.
With research and enough Vis, the crafters produce a Node Stabilizer. A wrong arrangement or insufficient Vis cannot pay for a result.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.switch.ob: Attach Create's native Threshold Switch so its observation face touches the essentia storage to monitor.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.switch.th: Open it to set separate upper and lower thresholds. Values count Essentia, not fluid millibuckets.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.switch.on: At the upper threshold, the switch turns its redstone output on.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.switch.ho: Between the thresholds, the previous output is retained to prevent rapid switching.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.switch.of: At the lower threshold, the switch turns off again. The output can also be inverted.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.switch.fi: An aspect filter limits which Essentia is counted. Without one, it monitors the combined stock.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.coupler.l: Place the lower Suspension Coupler facing upward on the structure that will move.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.coupler.u: Place its partner directly above, facing downward and attached to the upper structure.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.coupler.r: The base reach is 10 blocks. Stacking up to two more upward couplers below adds 10 blocks each.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.coupler.m: When a supported moving structure assembles, the paired section joins it across the gap.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.coupler.b: Keep the vertical connection clear. A full solid block between the pair prevents pairing.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.magnet.ca: Use Thaumic Magnetic Casing as the target, and connect the blocks that should travel with it.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.magnet.pu: Power the back shaft of the Kinetic Magnet. It attracts the target casing toward its front face.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.magnet.ra: Targets must be inside the forward cone. Base reach is 16 blocks; Aer and Ordo Vis can extend it to 64.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.magnet.op: Rotation speed controls travel. The side option chooses placement on arrival; right-click the front to change easing.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.magnet.pa: Redstone prevents new captures. Keep the destination clear so the structure can arrive safely.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.depot.sel: With another Floating Depot in hand, sneak-right-click an unpaired input Depot to select it.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.depot.dis: Place the output Depot next. The sum of X, Y and Z distances must be at most 8 blocks.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.depot.thr: Set the departure amount on the input. It waits for enough items, an empty output and no redstone signal.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.depot.unl: The plate carries its items to the output. Remove the items there before the plate can return.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.depot.ret: Only the input accepts new deliveries. Let the plate return home before feeding the next batch.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.depot.boo: Aer Vis at the input triples flight speed. Both endpoints and their chunks must remain available.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.spout.mou: Place an Essentia Spout two blocks above a Depot or Belt, leaving one block for the item.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.spout.fee: Feed Essentia from the top or sides. One Spout stores up to 64 points of a single aspect.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.spout.rec: A compatible item waits below the Spout until the current recipe step has enough Essentia.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.spout.res: For example, one Iron Ingot and 4 Praecantatio make one Thaumium Ingot.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.spout.ord: Follow the order shown in JEI. Multi-aspect Crucible steps may need several Spouts, including repeated portions over 64.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.spout.fil: The side filter can select an aspect or result. It helps keep recipes with the same input from choosing the wrong output.

thaumicomniverse.tutorial.thaumic_casing: Used in Omniverse machinery recipes and connected casing surfaces.
thaumicomniverse.tutorial.thaumic_hand_c: A long-lasting manual source of rotation.
Right-click to turn for 4 seconds; sneak to reverse the direction.
Use-core Golems can operate it and distribute work across adjacent cranks.
Stores compressed air and provides Void Metal protection.
Place it and supply rotation to refill air, then pick it up to wear it.
Its durability repairs itself, but this does not replenish air.
thaumicomniverse.tutorial.solid_aura_blo: A compact storage form of Solid Aura.
Craft it back into Solid Aura for use or processing.
thaumicomniverse.tutorial.solid_aura.2: Use one to release six random primal aspect orbs.
thaumicomniverse.tutorial.solid_aura.3: See JEI for charging, fluid and solidification recipes.
thaumicomniverse.tutorial.magic_hand.1: An enchanted extension of the Extendo Grip.
thaumicomniverse.tutorial.magic_hand.2: Each held Magic Hand adds half a block of reach beyond the normal grip bonus.
thaumicomniverse.tutorial.magic_hand.3: Supports the Repair enchantment for Vis-powered durability recovery.
thaumicomniverse.tutorial.void_sandpaper: Reusable sandpaper made with Void Metal.
Use it for ordinary sandpaper polishing. Its durability gradually repairs itself.

tc.research_text.thaumicomniverse:AIRSHI: Sailing the arcane routes of the sky
omniverse.page.airships.assembly: Apply a void plate to an arcane casing by hand or deployer. Configure and confirm the station anchor and forward direction. A casing placed at the anchor immediately becomes a core; its top arrow points forward. Enter assembly mode, glue the hull and add at least one set of controls. Each ship has one core.
omniverse.page.airships.routes: Connect anchors within 256 blocks on each axis, including parallel routes. The map displays individual blocks from loaded client chunks. Scroll to zoom, middle-drag to rotate, WASD to pan. Drag control points; Shift locks to Y, Ctrl to X, Alt to Z. Confirm to save. Occupied curves cannot be reshaped, but may be deleted, leaving the ship off route. Sneak-use a station to show its anchor direction and all connected colored curves.
omniverse.page.airships.driving: Use the controls: W advances, S brakes and turns back after stopping, A/D selects the next exit. Hold Jump to approach and dock without W. Doors open while docked and close on departure. Alignment requires docking; disassembly requires alignment. Relocation can move a ship off route. Hold Jump to return to the nearest route, or press W to start an automatic curved return, joining in the direction closest to the bow.
omniverse.page.airships.automatic: Craft an Airship Schedule from a Create schedule and purple dye. Use it or the station button to open the native editor. It is exclusive to airships; give it to the onboard arcane blaze driver. Empty-hand use pauses/resumes; sneak-use retrieves it. Destinations, titles, throttle and native wait conditions are supported. The fuel interface extracts Potentia from the container above, providing 60 seconds of powered travel per point by default. Top speeds are half their Create train counterparts.
omniverse.page.airships.lifecycle: Each route is one signal section and each station has one berth. Wrench a node, then use a signal within 32 blocks to bind it; repeated use cycles routes. Green is clear, red occupied, grey invalid. Manual and automatic driving reserve routes and destination berths. Logical vehicles persist and advance outside loaded chunks.

omniverse.page.arcane_assembly.infused: For an infused mechanism, start with a thaumium sheet, deploy an ender pearl and balanced shard, infuse, then press. Infusion must still be started manually. Crucible steps may also be completed by sequential essentia spouting. See JEI for all ingredients and aspects.
omniverse.page.arcane_assembly.outcomes: Alchemical mechanisms succeed at 75%, with quartz (15%) or an iron nugget (10%) as scrap. Infused mechanisms succeed at 70%, with a thaumium nugget (15%), amber (10%) or quartz (5%) as scrap. Outcomes are exclusive and sum to 100%.

thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.restored_: Ancient and Eldritch altars use the same shape as the original altar. Keep the central Pedestal, Matrix and all eight stones in one family.
Ancient altars provide an Essentia discount and modest speed gain, at the cost of extra instability.
Eldritch altars are faster and more stable, but consume more Essentia.
Put Infusion Speed Stones directly below the four pillars to shorten the processing cycle.
Efficiency Stones in the same positions save Essentia, but lengthen the cycle.
Surrounding Pedestals also affect the balance. Compare speed, consumption and stability for the recipe you intend to run.
The back connects to an ordinary Essentia pipe. The front faces the area containing the Jars.
The Essentia Extractor takes Essentia from its rear pipe and sends it into accepting Jars in front.
The Essentia Injector works in the opposite direction, fetching the aspect requested by the rear pipe.
Keep storage in the forward half of the search area, within 16 blocks along each axis and in loaded chunks.
An Injector needs a specific aspect demand. A pipe with no suction or no requested aspect will not draw from the Jars.
airship.rejoin.no_curve: No suitable return bend to a nearby route

omniverse.page.extremely_primordial_pear: Infusing a Primordial Pearl produces an Extremely Primordial Pearl. Add one to the Infinity Catalyst recipe; it is returned after crafting and can be used again.
omniverse.page.akashic_record: Combine knowledge with the power of infinity to create an Akashic Record. Use it while holding it to consume one record and gain 999 research points in every aspect.
omniverse.page.thaumic_crushing_wheel:
A pair of counter-rotating Thaumic Crushing Wheels processes items at half the usual crushing speed, yielding one essence crystal for every point of each aspect. Items without aspects are destroyed. Creatures killed by these wheels also yield crystals for all of their aspects.
Starting with a crushing wheel, deploy an alchemical brass sheet (or a brass sheet when unavailable), add 8 perditio, 100 mB of liquid death and 8 aqua, then deploy a thaumium sheet. Repeat this sequence five times.
focus.upgrade.thaumicomniverse.relocatio: Release use to throw the structure. Gravity pulls it down; collisions and unloaded chunks turn it back into blocks.
task.thaumicomniverse.wand_combat.desc: Fight with the main-hand wand and select offensive foci from the inventory or focus pouches. Sneak-use a golem bell on the maid, then use up to eight charging stations to bind them; sneak-use a station to unbind. Low-vis wands recharge out of combat and are retrieved before following the owner away.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.shared.crushing_: Place two Thaumic Crushing Wheels with one block between their centres. Both axles must point along the same axis.
Drive the wheels in opposite directions so their inner edges draw items down through the gap.
Items become Essence Crystals: one crystal for each point of every aspect on the item.
At the same rotation speed, these wheels process items at half the speed of ordinary Crushing Wheels.
Items without aspects are destroyed without producing crystals. These conversions have no individual JEI recipes.
Creatures killed by these wheels also yield crystals for all of their aspects. Nonlethal hits do not yield crystals.
Craft with five sequenced-assembly loops: Crushing Wheel, alchemical brass sheet (or brass), 8 Perditio, 100 mB Liquid Death, 8 Aqua, and a thaumium sheet.
thaumicomniverse.ponder.tag.futures.desc: Restored structures and devices from Thaumic Futures
modifier.thaumicomniverse.undertow.descr: Each level adds 1 warp and repairs 1 durability every 5 seconds.
modifier.thaumicomniverse.void_touch.des: Successful melee hits inflict Weakness for 3 seconds, one amplifier per level.
modifier.thaumicomniverse.arcane_smith.d: Each level adds 100% mining speed against Thaumcraft and supported addon blocks.
modifier.thaumicomniverse.imbued.descrip: With sufficient carried vis, gain 30% mining speed and melee damage per level. Costs 0.01 of each primal per broken block or 0.1 per hit; cost doubles per level.
modifier.thaumicomniverse.divine_realm.d: Unbreakable. Pickaxe-type tools mine instantly in the Bedrock Dimension, retaining their native area. Never opens portals.
modifier.thaumicomniverse.apocalypse.des: Adds one upgrade slot per level. While flying or gliding, gain 40% mining speed and damage and ignore the airborne mining penalty. Flight bonuses do not stack.
modifier.thaumicomniverse.aura_repair.de: Up to level II, using Salis Mundus. Like Repair, consumes carried vis every 2 seconds to restore durability equal to its level. Requires an Omniverse material part.
modifier.thaumicomniverse.runic_shield.d: Armor only, up to level III, using Primal Charms. Adds 2 runic shielding per level. Requires an Omniverse material part.
modifier.thaumicomniverse.requires_mater: Requires at least one Omniverse material part
omniverse.page.universal_enchantments: You have unified foreign enchantments with the principles of infusion. Complete this research to unlock every infusion enchantment provided by Thaumic Omniverse for installed mods; no individual research is required. The following pages list their recipes, which can also be found in a recipe viewer. Put an eligible item on the central pedestal, arrange the listed components, and start with a wand. Compatibility, level limits, experience and aspect costs still apply. With Apotheosis, infusion can reach one level beyond its effective limit; only that final level requires a void seed.
omniverse.page.guide_omniverse.intro:
The Omniverse carries the principles of thaumaturgy into the worlds of other mods: machines can consume essentia, and ores and enchantments alike fit into the framework of infusion.

General research that needs no other mod sits at the centre of this page. Create integration lies to the north, industrial integration to the west, infusion to the south, and backpacks and endgame integration to the east. Each area appears only when the matching mod is installed.

Translucent icons mirror research from other pages. Click one to jump to the original.
omniverse.page.guide_omniverse.index:
General research:
%1$s: purifying any ore into clusters.
%2$s: transmutation between metals.
%3$s: essentia tubes that push on demand.
%4$s: a record of scanned aura nodes.
%5$s: infusion recipes for other mods' enchantments.

Growing from %6$s: %7$s, %8$s, %9$s and %10$s.
omniverse.page.guide_create.intro:
Create's cogs and thaumic essentia can drive one another.

Everything begins with %1$s, which adds essentia to sequenced assembly. %2$s then lets arcane devices work as part of moving contraptions.

%3$s houses most arcane machines and leads to power sources, wand charging and crushing.
omniverse.page.guide_create.index:
Power: %1$s, %2$s, %3$s

Devices: %4$s, %5$s

Essentia: %6$s, %7$s, %8$s

Suspension: %9$s, %10$s, %11$s

Wand foci: %12$s, %13$s

Once you have mastered %14$s, you can begin building %15$s.
omniverse.page.guide_industry.intro: Essentia is a form of energy too. The research below connects thaumaturgy with the industrial mods you have installed:
omniverse.page.guide_industry.gtceu: GregTech: %1$s leads to %2$s, which processes thaumic metals in industrial forms; %3$s turns essentia into power.
omniverse.page.guide_industry.thermal: Thermal Series: %1$s burns essentia for power.
omniverse.page.guide_industry.hostilenet: Hostile Neural Networks: %1$s reconstructs thaumic matter from combat data.
omniverse.page.guide_industry.draconic: Draconic Evolution: %1$s gives wands discounts and potential. (South of the centre, growing from the infusion mirror.)
tc.research_text.TUT_ADDON_THAUMICOMNIVE: 把神秘时代接入现代科技模组
omniverse.page.arcane_crafting_upgrade: Provides a nine-slot arcane crafting grid and a wand slot, also supporting ordinary crafting. Research, vis payments, equipment discounts and crafting remainders follow the arcane workbench. Ingredients and the wand remain in the upgrade when removed. The tab shows discounted costs in red when vis is insufficient. A workbench charger above a placed backpack charges its crafting wand and stored wands.
omniverse.node_upgrade.empty: Use on an energized node to capture and remove it from the world.
omniverse.page.energized_node_upgrade: Use an empty upgrade on an energized node to capture it. The node is removed from the world; its permanent supply rates are preserved without temporary amplifier bonuses. Installed upgrades share each primal aspect's cv/t budget across the arcane crafting wand and stored wands every tick. More wands do not multiply the budget. Supply rates appear in the tooltip. Removing the upgrade retains the node; disabling it stops charging.
